content.text: KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.3（200052）：修复老版本游戏（如 a1.0.17_02）在内置 JRE8 上进入游戏即崩溃（FloatBuffer NoSuchMethodError，LWJGL 已改用 JDK8 编译兼容）；崩溃弹窗新增「上报给开发者」按钮（一键调用手机邮箱发至 2416444244@qq.com）；关于页补回龙腾猫跃鸣谢。保留陶瓦联机与 KCL 社区联机大厅，可在软件内直接检查更新。赞助 https://b23.tv/o42pOXH。

KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.3 (200052): fixed the crash when entering old versions (e.g. a1.0.17_02) on the built-in JRE 8 (FloatBuffer NoSuchMethodError; LWJGL now compiled with JDK 8); the crash dialog has a new "Report to developer" button that opens the device mail app addressed to 2416444244@qq.com; LTCatt restored in the About page. Terracotta online and the KCL community lobby are kept. Sponsor: https://b23.tv/o42pOXH.
